extDescription.message: Mooogor is a browser new tab page designed to help you enter your next workflow faster and more efficiently, such as opening frequently used websites, searching across sites, or restoring recently closed tabs.

nt_permission_desc.message: This extension does not collect personal data. Feel free to grant permission.

nt_settings_new_tab_open.message: Open links in a new tab

nt_settings_new_tab_tip.message: Automatically enabled when pinned to the tab bar.

nt_about_name_origin_desc.message: Mooogor sounds like the Sichuan dialect phrase "Moge'er", which means pickpocket. I also used many free and open-source frameworks and libraries while building this project. In daily work, we all benefit directly or indirectly from other developers' contributions, so in that sense, we are all "Moge'er".

nt_about_design_goal_desc.message: I reviewed many new tab pages, and most feel like a desktop with lots of utility widgets, such as calendars, tasks, and clocks. In Mooogor's design logic, flashy cards may interrupt the original purpose of opening a new tab, so support for such features will have lower priority. Features that help reduce time spent on the new tab will have much higher priority, and your suggestions are welcome.

nt_about_free_desc.message: Mooogor is free. I would only consider charging for features that require cloud services, because cloud providers have costs. Considering security and privacy, I will prioritize offline solutions whenever possible. If Mooogor meets your expectations for a new tab page, you can also support me to help keep improvements coming.
